steps.progression: Many songs use just three chords. Built on the 1st, 4th and 5th notes of the {cScale}, they are {cMajor} (I), {fMajor} (IV) and {gMajor} (V). The left hand plays them close together: {c} {e} {g}, {c} {f} {a} and {b} {d} {g}, with fingers 5-3-1, 5-2-1 and 5-3-1.
steps.leftHand: I, IV, V and back to I with the left hand, a whole bar each.
steps.leftHandInTime: Now in time, two beats per chord.
steps.jingleBells: “Jingle Bells” with the melody in the right hand and I, IV and V in the left: one chord per bar.
steps.jingleBellsInTime: Now in time with the metronome.
